data.body: Gerrit 3186 patch set 1: LLM-Review +1, Verified -1. All 3 failing CI jobs (ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13) failed the same 3 tests and nothing else (about 20,080 passed per job). (1) tests/unit/test_fixture_env_repr_security.py loads tests.scripts.test_observability_exit as a pytest plugin from a nested pytest rooted outside tests/, where tests/scripts is not on sys.path, so the new import of _observability_harness raised ModuleNotFoundError (2 tests). (2) tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py::test_safe_boundary_is_not_unwrapped_in_repository_tests flagged run_observability passing env=dict(env), which unwraps the redacted SubprocessEnv. Fix in patch set 2: moved the helper to tests/_observability_harness.py (beside _subprocess_env.py; mechanism marker updated to that path), passed env through unwrapped, and gave test_observability_exit.py the same explicit sys.path bootstrap tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py uses for this nested-plugin case. Local after the fix: those 2 modules plus all of tests/scripts/: 1675 passed, 2 skipped; make lint rc 0; make typecheck rc 0. The helper's path changed from the planned tests/scripts/_observability_harness.py to tests/_observability_harness.py, so file_impact and the description are being updated and the plan re-reviewed.
